_comment: Edit this file to publish incidents. `impact` is one of: degraded, partial_outage, major_outage, maintenance. `status` is investigating | identified | monitoring | resolved. Updates are newest-first. `date` is the incident day (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). Active (non-resolved) incidents appear in the banner at the top.

incidents.title: Elevated latency on Hosted MCP
incidents.summary: Some MCP requests saw elevated latency for ~20 minutes.

updates.label: Resolved
updates.body: Latency has returned to normal levels. The root cause was a slow cold start after a deploy; we have raised the minimum instance count to prevent recurrence.

updates.label: Monitoring
updates.body: A fix has been applied and we are monitoring recovery.

updates.label: Investigating
updates.body: We are investigating reports of elevated latency on the Hosted MCP endpoint.
